5056095713160.sourceDescription:
Make Christmas feel special with our Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Its natural-looking foliage and classic shape create a welcoming focal point, ready to dress with treasured decorations and your own choice of festive lights.

This tree combines realistic PE tips with PVC foliage for a beautifully full appearance. The blend of PE tips and PVC tips creates texture and depth, giving your Christmas decorations a rich green setting.

Choose a timeless look with warm white lights and delicate ornaments, or fill the branches with colourful baubles and family favourites. Supplied without lights, this Fraser Fir lets you create your own festive style and change the look from year to year.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, ready for you to gently arrange and shape. The included folding metal stand provides a practical base and packs away neatly when the festivities are over.

Features: 
 Mixed foliage for a realistic, full appearance
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 Unlit, ready for your own choice of lights
 Suitable for indoor use only

For the best finish, gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's full shape before decorating.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 135cm
Tip count: 1295 (400 PE and 895 PVC)
Lights and decorations not included
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product Features

Grand single-door entryway arch: Measuring 8.9 ft H x 5.2 ft W (270 x 160 cm) with an inner clearance of 100. W x 220. H cm, this Christmas arch is perfectly sized to frame standard single doorways up to 100 cm wide, instantly transforming your entrance into a festive holiday focal point.

Snow-flocked winter beauty: Featuring 1,400 dense branch tips with a snowy flocked finish, this flocked Christmas tree archway creates a full, lush silhouette, bringing the charm of a romantic winter wonderland to your holiday decor.

Flame-retardant & pet-friendly materials: Crafted from pet-friendly, flame-retardant materials, this artificial Christmas tree provides added peace of mind around holiday lights and is designed for homes with curious pets, even if they occasionally or lick the branches.

Stable frame & compact storage: This Christmas tree arch features a steel base with 8 metal ground stakes for reliable stability, while the 7-section trunk disassembles for compact storage. Allow 45–60 minutes for fluffing to create a full, snowy look and enjoy its festive charm year after year.

Versatile seasonal accent: This snow Christmas tree beautifully frames entryways, doorways, or festive event spaces, smoothly adding a romantic winter forest touch and a warm, welcoming holiday atmosphere for family and guests.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5096042286460.sourceDescription:
Twenty-five pink PVC baubles measure 6 cm in diameter and have hanging eyes at the top. Their rounded shapes create a repeating colour accent for Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands. The coordinated contents let you plan the main colours and shapes before placing the individual decorations, so the arrangement can follow the space available.

The plastic construction provides the shape for the decorative finish. Each piece can be moved between branches as you arrange the tree, so you can judge the balance of the display before settling on a position. Keep the front and outline visible by allowing some space between neighbouring decorations, particularly where several branches meet.

The hanging loops give you a defined attachment point at the top of each decoration. Place the loop over a suitable branch or support, then turn the ornament towards the room. Working from the larger open spaces towards the smaller gaps makes it easier to see where another decoration would add colour without concealing the pieces already in place.

The rounded shape gives these decorations a familiar bauble outline. Repeating that shape across several branches creates a rhythm through the tree without needing every ornament in the wider display to match. A small group can also be used within a wreath or garland, placing the balls where their curved surfaces are visible between the greenery.

Designed as hanging decorations, the pieces can be distributed across the branches or brought together in a smaller seasonal arrangement. Start with the areas that face into the room, then turn the individual ornaments until their shapes can be seen.

When taking down the display, remove each decoration from its support before packing it away. Keep the pieces together and avoid placing heavy objects against their decorative faces. This keeps the collection organised for the next time you arrange a Christmas tree or seasonal display.

 This 2.1-meter smart Christmas tree waterfall light is a newly upgraded festive decorative light equipped with 400 high-density RGB LED beads.

 Supported by intelligent APP and remote control functions, it features point-to-point pixel control, DIY text editing, custom pattern drawing, dynamic scene modes and music sync rhythm lighting.

 Total Length: 2.1 Meters
 LED Quantity: 400 High-Bright RGB LED Beads

MUSIC SYNC LIGHTING EFFECTS: Built-in microphone enables the lights to twinkle and change colors synchronously following your favorite music rhythm. Create immersive dynamic lighting shows for Christmas parties and celebrations.

RICH COLOR Modes & Widely Application: One-click color filling allows quick atmosphere adjustment. Perfect for Christmas, Halloween, holiday parties, yard, garden and home decoration. The star topper completes your festive tree lighting.

5060445494760.sourceDescription: Dress your dog for Christmas with this red and white bandana-style collar. The collar has a triangular front carrying the white "Yappy Christmas" message. Snowflakes and pawprints surround the greeting, while white and silver furry trim runs along the upper edge. Together, the printed motifs and trim give the accessory a seasonal look for a dog without a full costume. A Velcro fastening lets you fit and remove the collar without tying a separate scarf. Position the triangular section at the front of your dog's neck so the words and pattern can be seen in photographs. Use the collar for a family Christmas picture, a festive gathering or a holiday visit. One collar is included for a single dog outfit. The red body contrasts with the white lettering and snowflake details, and the silver-toned trim adds another decorative touch. Before dressing your pet, check that the collar sits comfortably around the neck and does not restrict movement. Make sure the Velcro fastening is secure. Supervise your dog while it is wearing the accessory and remove it if it causes discomfort. After the celebration, follow any care directions provided with the product and store the collar for a future Christmas event.

Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.

Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark green eucalyptus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.

5096042277260.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - 50 LEDs and 82 branches, timer function for a Christmas wall display - PVC, 60 cm
5096042277260.sourceDescription:
A 60 cm PVC wreath with 82 branches provides the framework for 50 battery-operated LEDs. The timer switches off the lights after their set period, a practical feature when the wreath hangs in a busy entrance.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Choose the start of the lighting period with the room's usual evening routine in mind. It is worth checking the controls while the wreath is still within reach, before moving it to its final position.

Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

A lit wreath can provide the evening detail in a hallway where there is little space for a tree. Keeping the surface below it simple lets the outline show up after dark and leaves room for the everyday use of the entrance. A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent.
50 battery-operated LEDs illuminate the wreath with a built-in timer for convenient automatic control.
Constructed from durable PVC with 82 realistic branches, creating a festive and textured appearance.
Features a practical timer function that automatically switches off the lights after a set period.
Versatile design suitable for hanging on doors or walls to enhance Christmas decor in any space.
Comes with Timer function

This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Remote Control
Remote control makes adjustments accessible from a distance. This is useful when the item is placed away from your usual sitting or working position.

Battery Powered
Battery power gives flexibility over positioning without relying on a nearby mains socket during use. Fit the specified battery type and follow the supplied instructions.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

5010789465360.baseName: Bartoline Boiled Linseed Oil Highly Refined Wood Garden Furniture Treatment 2L
5010789465360.variantName: Bartoline Boiled Linseed Oil Highly Refined Wood Garden Furniture Treatment 2L
5010789465360.sourceDescription:
Boiled Linseed Oil is especially suitable for use on soft wood garden furniture. The oil protects wood from drying out after long periods in the sun and gives it a natural sheen that lasts. Boiled Linseed Oil contains additives to speed up the drying process. Hardwoods such as Oak and Teak should be treated with Teak Oil.

Preparation:
Ensure that the surface to be treated is clean and dry. Remove any paint or stain with sandpaper. Wipe the surface with a cloth dampened with White Spirit to remove any grease or dirt. Treat any mildew etc. with Fungicidal Wash.

Application:
Apply Boiled Linseed Oil liberally using a clean cloth or brush and rub in well, remove excess. For best results apply 2 or 3 coats allowing 24 hours between coats.

After Care:
Soiled application cloths should not be left where they may constitute a fire hazard as they can be liable to self-igniting without warning. Immediately after use, wash all cloths with soapy water and dispose of safely outside. Clean equipment with White Spirit.

5010789720360.sourceDescription: Bartoline 1876 Ready Mixed Fine Surface Filler is a high quality ready to use filler developed for the professional user. Its formulation is ideal for repairs to small holes, dents and nicks and a wide range of imperfect interior surfaces. The fine particles enable a smooth finish which dries white and may be overpainted. Suitable to use on walls, ceilings, doors, skirtings and window frames. Bartoline Fine Surface Filler has good adhesion and gives a strong repair in all applications.PREPARATIONEnsure surfaces to be filled are clean, dry and dust free. Hairline cracks should be slightly enlarged to ensure good filler penetration. Lightly moisten highly absorbent surfaces with water prior to application. Touch in nail and screw heads with an oil-based paint to prevent rusting.DIRECTIONSIf necessary, stir filler before use to an even, smooth consistency. Apply a thin layer of filler over the repair using a filling instrument or trowel and press firmly into the cavity, ensuring that the repair is completely filled. If a deeper repair is required, build up the filler in thinner layers, or use Bartoline 1876 All Purpose Filler, followed by the Fine Surface Filler. For a perfect finish, fill slightly proud of the surrounding area and use fine abrasive to blend in the repair.CLEANING and STORAGEAfter use, ensure lid is firmly replaced to prevent contents from drying. Remove excess filler from tools prior to cleaning. Clean tools with water before filler sets hard PROTECT FROM FROST.

7984704610860.sourceDescription:
This stunning Christmas tree not only boasts a beautiful appearance, but also offers a variety of features that will enhance your Christmas experience. With 1116 PVC tips and pine needles, 70 pine cones, and 70 clusters of red berries, this tree creates a lifelike and festive atmosphere. And the snowy design adds a touch of winter magic, making it the centerpiece of any room. More than that, it comes with 11 wonderful lighting modes, including warm-white and colorful lights, which can be easily switched to match your mood or decoration theme. In addition, Safety is always a top priority, which is why this tree is made of flame-retardant PVC material, ensuring peace of mind while enjoying the magic of the season. And the hinged structure and 3-section design make installation a breeze. Whether it's in your living room, office, or even as a gift for your loved ones, it will bring joy and holiday spirit to any space.
The 1116 lush branch tips are designed with 2 types of leaves, look full and vivid
70 natural pine cones and 70 clusters of vivid red berries for added realism
11 lighting modes: combination, C1 steady on, C2 steady on, C1 mixture, C2 mixture, Slo-Glo, breathing, C1 Slo-Glo, C2 Slo-Glo, flash, in wave
Designed with 400 color-changeable lights, emit warm-white or multi-color lighting
The crossed base provides reliable support, keeping the tree upright and secure
The hinged structure makes it easy to set up and take down, saving time and effort
Manufacturer guarantee: 6 months
Tree type - Hinged
Assembly required
With stand
